disposition: Server-level routes exist behind the local gate (/health, /v1/metrics, /v1/audit, /v1/engine/health|status|topology|shutdown) with tests for gate refusal and supervision behavior. The V1 /admin families (certificates, studio, operations-server, tcp-connection-info) are neither enumerated nor dispositioned, and no V1 authorization-marker or debug-flag classification exists on V2 server routes.
